comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
English name is "Goddess Moonstone".
Obtained from searching in yellow pillar spot in "Temple of Artemis in Ephesus", the new legacy inland which can be assessed by doing "Ephesus the Land of Goddess". Materials used for Sophia Awakening recipes shown above.

In-game description:
A precious and mysterious stone that received the power of the moon goddess. It is said to bring revelation to people.
